name: automation-report-delivery
prompt: Read the newest committed automation report bundle through read-only Investor MCP tools. If delivery_action is SILENT or no new NOTIFY bundle exists, return exactly [SILENT]. Otherwise explain only the bundle facts, data date, quality, reason code and one permitted user action. Never call a write tool and never claim delivery has already succeeded.
note: Enable only after the target Hermes Cron schema and delivery channel are verified.
